header.name: Advances in Deep Learning
header.description: Contemporary advances in the field of DL is rapid and it is necessary to cover the recent topics to keep up pace with the ongoing research. The course introduces recent literature in different areas – over parameterized networks, understanding solutions of gradient descent, robustness, generative models, optimal transport theory, contrastive and meta learning, and diffusion models. The students registering for this course should have basic knowledge in ML/DL.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Student will develop an understanding of the various key paradigms of deep learning

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to demonstrate an understanding of robustness and generalization of models

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to apply approaches for problem solving

resources.title: Topics will be covered from recent research articles
